population.description: The same draw's federalregister.gov HTML renditions. Decision 0001 named this population and the first calibration never read it; amendment B5 makes it the HTML floor's population.

metric.denominator: the captured rendition's bytes, whitespace-normalized: every maximal run of ASCII whitespace becomes one space and the ends are stripped
metric.normalization: both sides by the same rule, so the publisher's indentation cancels and the two extractors -- one laying out verbatim, one laying out normalized -- are commensurable
metric.numerator: the extracted representation's bytes, whitespace-normalized by the same rule
